sentences.text: Vanessa atalanta is an insect in the order Lepidoptera, listed as least concern (LC).
In Mainz-Bingen, 594 reports over ten years show a main time of Feb–Apr and Jun–Oct.
It has been recorded eating English Ivy, Valeriana rubra, Stinging Nettle and Red Clover.
European hornet and European bee-eater are recorded as predators.
It pollinates Field Eryngo and has been recorded visiting flowers of Common Lilac, Hemp Agrimony, Creeping Thistle and common dandelion.
